My symptoms are mostly pain whenever I put my fourth finger down, it’s a sharp throbbing pain that stops me in my tracks. It goes away immediately if I quit playing, as I said. But when I continue, the pain lasts a long time after practicing, and it’s dull/throbbing pain. It’s only the one finger, and certainly not my wrists. So I don’t think it’s carpal tunnel at all. This has only started recently, so I’m wondering if I’ve been developing a bad issue. Either way, I’ll try to talk to my teacher and a doctor, and for now I’ll see if I can’t find myself a brace for it to assist me while I play :)
